notes.title: 1.3.0 UI update
notes.content:
Hi!

[h3][b]I finally did it, I replaced most PICO-8 font with a more readable font! [/b][/h3]

To get some background, Cards started it's life as a tiny pico-8 game. When I started remaking it, I decided to keep the pico-8 spirit as much as possible, using the same color palette, the same font and the same control scheme. However during development I steered away from those limitations so that I could create a better game. However a lot of UI was only made to fit the smaller font, so it was kept.

Now I took the time to remake the UI to fit a larger font and I think it is worth it! 

[h2]Here are some after and before pictures![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/18fcc83f4b7ed228498de4babf75dbb2426ec303.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/9a7cff93294fe49fc088473a606bb22128d7ce23.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/30af73fa81ce4c97ed4a5fee3a1b7c3a08a4242d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/df8296622af40a7984e6974b3e7f4ecc198577c2.png[/img]

I also cleaned up some UI to make it more readable, the list would be too big if I would write down all the small changes. Hope you like it!

[i]/ Sebastian[/i]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Release
notes.content:
Hello again!

This is a big patch so buckle up!

[h2]Building changes[/h2]

There were only two of them before, but with the addition of three new ones I knew that I had to make some changes. I decided to treat them as minions but with some extra rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/6c18d4cfba5ddcfd7cc142ff1bfbc7e705fdf8ed.png[/img]

They now stay active between turns and are moved to the graveyard when no defence is left or when replaced by another building.

This should make them more balanced as now you cannot pick up all the buildings during a round without sacrificing some defence. 

[h2]New Cards[/h2]

[b]BEE Aidoxe Statue[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/bafe4944a83fdd539403dec4217479201c2077ac.png[/img]

[b]Posh Tooth Fairy[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/8e2f49ad95dbca2f52cf3babd1d6f42316f9fb97.png[/img]

[b]Peaceful Robot[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/91ffbc98c1c654ab3eccf220467810d40bf3dfa8.png[/img]

[b]Wild Stone[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/0b481c741a754a7422c959a6cbe46df4ee060f29.png[/img]

[b]Glitchy Furnace[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/864fe3ec9887a3997f1f414d4e6cdd81652965e0.png[/img]

[h2]New mode[/h2]

I wanted a mode that could be played forever but also relaxing. So Daily mode was created!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952595/d66ceb63f6c15540beb629694a1551ca80b164f5.png[/img]

Three modifiers is picked out based on the date. They can be positive, like starting with better cards, or negative like taking damage every time you discard a card. 

A random boss will also be picked out. 

You have one try each day! Some days will be very tricky and other days the luck will be on your side.
Hope you have fun playing this mode!

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

[b]Temporary house[/b]
Block 4 -> 3

[b]Overworked programmer[/b]
1 Attack -> 2 Gold

[b]Trickster Hipster[/b]
Gold 2 -> 1
+ 1 draw

[b]Challenge mode[/b]
- Start health 32 -> 30

[h2]General changes[/h2]

- Added a floor indication so its easier to see that new floors unlocks in the boss view
- Improve the background when last boss is selected in the boss view
- Improve readability on the info banner
- Improve readability all over the game
- Bug fixes

[h3][u]Maybe most important with this patch is the secret I hid! Good luck finding it![/u][/h3]

Have an awesome day!

[i]/ Sebastian[/i]

notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch notes: Quality of life update
notes.content:
Hi again! 

These changes comes after some player feedback, hope you enjoy them. 

[list]
[*] Added a way to end a turn with a seperate button (space on a keyboard and back on a controller)
[*] Visuallise with a highlight if you have something to draw from your deck
[*] Made Controlling Dentist a 2 cost card, but removed the 1 hurt effect. It was just confusing when you ended a turn with 0 gold and the dialog still popped up
[/list]
[i]
/ Sebastian[/i]
